steps.text: 8:15 A.M. \ Overcast
Several kilometers from Londinium, adjacent plate

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Closure, we're getting a drone signal!

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Move, move, lemme see!

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Ooh... Woah, that's not half bad. The newly added camera module is working properly and has great clarity within a hundred meters.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: The battery life seems pretty stable too! Keep at it with this baby and we might even be able to get it over the wall and sneak a peek at what's going on inside...

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Hold on a sec, that's practically asking the enemy to shoot it out of the sky!

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Don't you worry, I wouldn't put everybody at risk like that.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: We've just gotta hurry up and develop that stealth coating...

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Closure, the drone's sending an alert!

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Got somebody within detection range... It's charging its automatic attack module.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Wait, wait, that's the rescue team! Disable the alert!

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Amiya, Doctor! Indra and Dagda are back!

options: Our scouts haven't found anyone yet.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: They sure are. Closure's been totally focused on her drone research the whole way here.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: She's trying to improve their recon capabilities so the enemy can't ambush us.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: That would be a big relief for you too, right?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: After all, this is our first operation since coming to Londinium, and I... I'm still a little worried.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Drones can do a lot to improve our sightlines.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Doctor, once we get into Londinium, all the hard work Closure has put into her drones might really come in handy.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Because... most of us don't have the slightest idea of what's going on in there. We're going to need more eyes.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Did it seem like Closure was kinda nervous?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: She hasn't left the landship for operations much before. And that's before we talk about how none of us know how long we'll be here.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But it's alright. I trust her, and I trust all our operators.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Whether it's the roughly-a-dozen operators following us, or Misery and Logos's two teams that went ahead of us...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Everyone signed up for this operation knowing exactly what we're here for.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: So far, we've successfully completed phase one and phase two of the operation. Now, we need to focus on phase three––

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Entering the city.

options: How are we going to infiltrate Londinium?
Are we going in through the structural level again?
If I'm scaling walls again, I'm gonna need a minute.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: We're not getting into Londinium the same way we got inside the Chernobog core city.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: We've got a visual on Londinium now, Doctor. Look at how high those walls are.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Nothing has ever managed to breach Londinium's defenses, not even Ursus's high-speed warships.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Londinium used to be the economic center of all Terra, as we all know, but only those who've seen the city with their own eyes understand its reputation as an impregnable fortress.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: The waste drainage structures of most nomadic cities are vulnerable infiltration from the outside, but the engineers who built Londinium even made use of this weak point.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Reportedly, they built an automatic assembly line into the underground structure––

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Back in Londinium's glory days, the machines worked day and night to perpetuate Victoria's golden age.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: In times of war, the assembly lines supplied weapons and ammunition to the defense systems built into their towering walls.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: The underground structure was designed so carefully that we wouldn't find a single gap in the engineering blueprints.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: And that's assuming we'd even be able to get our hands on Londinium's blueprints. That's kind of impossible in and of itself.

options: Then how did Logos and Misery get inside?
I thought Kal'tsit would be able to get us in.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Doctor, have some faith in our elite operators.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Blaze is an expert in high-mobility combat and Rosmontis is the core of our annihilation force, those two are masters of very particular Arts that are useful for infiltration missions.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Once you've seen Misery's Originium Arts in action, you'll understand what I mean.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: You've probably heard Lava talk about 'Spatial Arts'... That's heading in the right direction of explaining Misery's Arts, but it's not the whole story.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Before joining Rhodes Island, he even managed to infiltrate the dynastic catacombs of ancient Sargon.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: As for Logos... He has his own unique methods that require a specially trained caster.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I think, if there's a way for living things to get in and out of a city, there's no wall that could stop them.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: We also have another special operator joining us after we get into the city, but we probably won't be able to get in the same way she did.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I'm not too worried, Doctor.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: As you know, we have a plan. Once it's successfully put into motion, we'll all be much safer.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: And even if this plan doesn't work, we have a backup plan, and another one after that.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Doctor... I know you're just trying to lighten the mood.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Over the last year or so, we've held hundreds of intelligence meetings, and almost a thousand tactical simulations... We all know how hard Dr. Kal'tsit worked to make this operation possible.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But there are some things we can't do, no matter how much effort we put in... and that's true for our uniquely talented elite operators, Rhodes Island itself, and even Dr. Kal'tsit.

options: So that's why you found us a guide.
I'm really glad we're not starting with a fight.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Right... I wanted to try something a bit safer first.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: It brings to mind, Doctor, that meeting before we left, everyone was surprisingly on the same page here.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Even if we had the Rhodes Island landship, we'd basically be trying to shatter a boulder by throwing eggs at it. That's what Londinium is to us.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: We should save our strength for the tougher enemies. They're waiting out there.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Doctor, I can feel everyone getting tenser each day we get closer to Londinium...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But no matter what happens next, we're all ready to fight.

options: I'm worried about you too, Amiya.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Doctor...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: You already know. If we have to make a stand right here, it wouldn't be Closure doing it, or any of the operators who came here with their own ideals.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: The responsibility is mine... Umm, though maybe it would be Siege's too.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: ...Indra.

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: You're awake, Vina? You haven't gotten a wink of sleep all day. Might be good to get some shut-eye before we officially return to the city.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: I can't sleep..

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Shouldn't Indra and Dagda be back already?

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: Heh. I don't even know if I should be jealous of those two. Even though they signed up for the job to buy you time to rest up, they just worry you anyway.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: I should've gone with them. Ever since I came back, I can't close my eyes without seeing everything that happened back when we ran.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: If they're in danger, I should be with them... No, I should be standing in front of them.

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: Look, you... You always worry too much. They're just warming up a bit before their homecoming. How dangerous could it be?

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: Setting Dagda aside for now, did you see how fidgety Hannah looked? Hah.

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: If you didn't give her a little task to help her blow off steam, I bet she wouldn't have been able to control herself. Probably would've punched someone the moment we got back into the city.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: She handles herself a lot better now.

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: Hmph. If that was true, she wouldn't be arguing back and forth with Dagda all the time. Even though she knows you haven't been sleeping well, she still won't shut up.

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: How about it, Vina? Wanna sneak a peek at our old home while they're out?

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: They only know how to throw fists. I'm the brains here, so I'm naturally the most reliable.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Why are you talking smack behind our backs again?!

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: Look at that, Vina. Doesn't she seem more energetic than before?

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Hah.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: A laugh out of Vina?

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: You've been totally lost in thought this whole trip.

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: You idiot, why even talk about that? Do you know how hard it was for me to––

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Thank you, Morgan.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Except, I'd suggest you get some rest yourself. If I needed someone to manage my mood for me, I'd be a pretty useless leader.

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: Alright, sounds good to me.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Dagda.

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: Here.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: You're bleeding?

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: I'm fine. It's not my blood.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: I'm glad.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Those men... they were Dublinn, right? What'd you think of them?

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: They're about as strong as a regular standing army. And, the one squad captain that Indra and I took down fought with combat techniques that very distinctly showed signs of Victorian military training.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: In other words...

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: We might actually be dealing with a coup of some kind.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Are they working with the Sarkaz?

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: They've no love for the Sarkaz. But that probably hasn't stopped them from forging a temporary alliance.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: They want to carve up Londinium. No, probably much more than just Londinium.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Those dukes out there... How many of them support Dublinn? And how many... support the Sarkaz?

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: For shame! They'd rather let the flags of foreign foes fly over Londinium than let go of their pitiful little power struggles, obsessed with their game of political tug-o'-war.

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: These dukes and their troops are responsible for creating this crisis!

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: Now that we've come this far, it's finally time for us to put an end to this mess.

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: I've said it countless times: as a Knight of the Tower, my sword and I stand ready.

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: We're just waiting for you to lead us back to Londinium, and gather up all those willing to fight for you.

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: Dagda!

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: We agreed to not talk about that until after we got back.

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: But we're already at the gates of Londinium.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Didn't I tell you, Morgan? I'm not the only one who's sick of her. She's been acting a bit kooky lately, and she keeps blathering on about random nonsense.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Hey, Dagda, you don't even carry a sword on you, and I don't care if you're a knight or not. Just don't forget what weapon you have in your hands, and whose side you're on!

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Don't be too hard on her. Either of you.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: We... all have a past that we can't shrug aside. The reason we're all here today is precisely because we still have a score to settle.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: I've told you before, Dagda, I don't want to let any of you down.

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: Siege...

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: I'm sorry. I swore to trust you... and I swore to trust that you'd make the right decisions. But, I lost myself today.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Don't blame yourself.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Our primary objective is still to enter Londinium with Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Is the one you rescued talking to Amiya right now?

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: Yes. Balin took him to see Amiya and the Doctor.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Looks just like your average Londinier.

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: It could be a disguise.

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: The Dublinn fighters said he used to work for the Sarkaz, but deserted them.

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: Those Sarkaz... I've fought them before. They killed the other Knights of the Tower...

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Dagda.

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: I'm fine. But, we can't underestimate them. The fact that this guy managed to escape the city on their watch means he's probably more than meets the eye.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: If he really was that ordinary, Dublinn wouldn't care to abduct him, and Rhodes Island wouldn't be looking for him, right?

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Let's head over and see what's going on.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: I want to see... if he really can lead us into Londinium.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Amiya, there's a communication request on Blacksteel's channel.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Please put them through.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Amiya!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Did you get our signal? I'm sorry to say that by the time we got to the scene, the pilot Blacksteel hired was already dead.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: How could this happen...?

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Poor Thorpe... *sigh*, I'll let the rest of the team know.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: We also weren't able to retrieve the low-altitude aircraft. It was... um, destroyed during the battle.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Ugh, that aircraft was rented... But, umm, that's not too big of a problem. We still have spare vehicles, so that won't disrupt the operation.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Is Mr. Thomas with you right now?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Yes, he's a bit shaken up still, but doesn't seem to have any injuries. Our medics are looking after him right now.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Is he the informant you said could get us into Londinium?

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: That's right.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Mr. Thomas, who used to own a candy plant in Londinium's Sudean borough, and his uncle who lives in Columbia, are long-time partners of Blacksteel.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: His uncle put in a request to bring Mr. Thomas back to Columbia. The last time we talked, we told Mr. Thomas that we'd bring someone to pick him up if he found some way to leave Londinium.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: I just never expected...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: ...that Dublinn would hijack your aircraft. And by the way, they seem very interested in Mr. Thomas too.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Hm, really?

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: I suppose that's because... Mr. Thomas is very familiar with Sudean–– It's the place closest to you with a point of entry and exit.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: I'm sure he can help you find a suitable way in, and they're probably after him for very similar reasons.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Right. I'll ask if he is willing to help us, once he's rested up.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Umm... say again please? We've lost contact with the team sent to link up with the embassy? I, I see... Sorry, Amiya, but something just came up...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: That's alright. Take care of what you have to do first. We'll go talk to Mr. Thomas.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: D-Do your best... Um, I hope that doesn't come off the wrong way... Maybe there's a better way to say it...

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Amiya... and you too, Doctor. Good luck.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Mr. Thomas?

steps.name: Londinium Citizen
steps.text: So you're... the one.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Which one?

steps.name: Londinium Citizen
steps.text: We didn't expect you to come so quickly. Hmm... Quite an unexpected surprise.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Were we quick...?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: We've been worried about you ever since we heard from Blacksteel.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: By the way, Mr. Thomas, are you feeling unwell at all?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I just noticed that your expression... looks a bit different now.

steps.name: Londinium Citizen
steps.text: Aha... Haha. I might've gotten a bit ahead of myself.

steps.name: Londinium Citizen
steps.text: What I meant to say is, thank you.

steps.name: Londinium Citizen
steps.text: Madam, you and your subordinates saved me. I have no doubt that you are good people.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: There's no need to thank us. If you're a partner to Blacksteel, you're also a partner to us.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: And... there's something else I need your opinion on.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: We have work that needs doing inside Londinium. On our way here, we heard a little bit about what's going on inside the city.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Right now, Londinium isn't allowing anybody into the city without authorization.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: From the perspective of outside visitors like us, those high walls are an impossible obstacle.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: We've tried a few methods already, but it's far too difficult for a small business like ours to pass through a military blockade.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: As you can see, we have only a few office clerks with us, and we would like to know if there is a...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Safe way to get inside Londinium.

steps.name: Londinium Citizen
steps.text: You're... you're trying to get INSIDE Londinium? You know, the people inside are desperately trying to escape... Those damned Sarkaz, they're just too horrible!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I understand that.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: And it's why I'm not going to force you to help us.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I'm also not going to lie to you and try to cover up the potential dangers of working with us.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But if you're willing to show us the way, we'll escort you to Blacksteel's evacuation team, once all is said and done.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: If you don't want to go back, we won't blame you. You can go ahead and leave right now, and we'll look for another way into the city.

steps.name: Londinium Citizen
steps.text: Of course I...

options: If you leave, you may bump into Dublinn.
I understand the way out isn't exactly very safe.

steps.name: Londinium Citizen
steps.text: Of course I'll choose to work with you!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Doctor...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: (I never intended to threaten him... If he didn't want to help us, I would've arranged for someone to escort him...)

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Looks like we found our guide?

options: Mr. Thomas agreed to cooperate with us just now.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: It's time for our homecoming.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Closure, go ahead and call your drones back.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Woah... Are we finally going to start the operation?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: It's not safe to stay outside the city for too long either.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Thanks to Misery's intel, we've largely been able to bypass Dublinn's troops.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But we just got into a fight with Dublinn, and judging from previous experiences, the leader of that squad can be a bit... vengeful.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: You think they'll come after us?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I can't say for sure. That depends on whether or not they give up on Mr. Thomas.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Even if we successfully enter the city, we might end up having to fight the Sarkaz troops garrisoned inside and Dublinn's forces at the same time.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Ugh, if only I could splash a coat of stealth paint on our operators too...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: We'll be fine. We've already done everything we can to prepare for this day.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Doctor, please stand beside me. Just like always, I won't let anyone hurt you.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Let's... get ready to move out.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Attention, all members of Special Ops Squad Amiya––

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: We are now heading directly for the port at Sudean, Londinium!

steps.name: Dublinn Soldier
steps.text: Captain, I've checked our surroundings, and there are no signs of any Londiniers.

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: In other words, your entire squad wasn't enough to stop a few people, and you even let them take our crucial objective.

steps.name: Dublinn Soldier
steps.text: Captain...

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: Rubbish... the whole lot of you!

steps.name: Dublinn Soldier
steps.text: Ma'am...

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: Stop sniveling, it's irritating. When have you ever seen me hurt my own people? Besides, I'm not mad at you, I'm mad at myself.

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: Even something as minor as this... Not a single thing has gone smoothly since we've come to Londinium.

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: Those... damned Sarkaz... Those meddlesome nobles too...

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: And then there's that blasted Victorian soldier... the one they call 'Horn'...

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: It's all Harmonie's fault. She forced me to bring the wolf along to Londinium, with all that talk about how she'd be able to use the soldier to buy the support of some nobles sitting on the fence if she were to come here...

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: If I knew she was going to run away and continue to be a thorn in our side, I would've killed her right there at County Hillock!

steps.name: Dublinn Soldier
steps.text: Captain, this time, um... I don't think it was her...

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: It wasn't?

steps.name: Dublinn Soldier
steps.text: According to the survivors, the attackers were people we had never seen before. They didn't appear to be Victorian military either.

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: So what you're telling me is a couple of nobodies can appear out of thin air and snatch a man from right under our noses.

steps.name: Dublinn Soldier
steps.text: I-It's completely our fault, Captain! We'll track them down right away...

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: Hold it! Stop bumbling around. We're about to leave this place.

steps.name: Dublinn Soldier
steps.text: We're leaving...?

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: Otherwise? Do you plan on bunkering down on this street? We're not ready to go masks-off with the Sarkaz yet.

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: Also, I promised Harmonie that I'd let the nobles keep some of their stupid pride.

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: It's all... for the sake of Dublinn. For the Leader.

steps.name: Dublinn Soldier
steps.text: Understood, Captain.

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: You say you understand, but deep down, you don't understand anything at all. Otherwise, how would you have let that Londinier get away? Do you have any idea how important the information he has on him is?

steps.name: Dublinn Soldier
steps.text: Uhh... He was the one driving for the Sarkaz...

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: Yes... driving.

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: If he can drive for the Sarkaz, that obviously means he knows his way around!

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: He can help us find the ones we're looking for. Our compatriots who are still in Sarkaz hands... but are of great importance to us!

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: Why do you think I'm swallowing my disgust and dealing with the Sarkaz here in Londinium? Just the way they look at us makes me want to run them through with stones a hundred times over!

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: It's just because... after coming all this way, I can finally do something useful for the Leader!

steps.name: Dublinn Soldier
steps.text: I... I'm sorry, Captain...

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: A driver, a driver... Hmph, you just reminded me of something.

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: The ones who snatched him from us... Were they also looking for a guide?

steps.name: Dublinn Soldier
steps.text: Captain, do you mean...?

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: We're turning back right now.

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: I want to see if I come across any familiar faces at the port.

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: Say, for example... that bloody Victorian soldier.

steps.name: Dublinn Soldier
steps.text: Not so fast, you lot.

steps.name: Dublinn Soldier
steps.text: Once the Captain comes back and we get some reliable information, then we'll let you go.

steps.name: Dublinn Soldier
steps.text: To be honest, I'd rather not raise a hand against you. You've been slaves to the Sarkaz for so long, you can't even be called soldiers anymore.

steps.name: Dublinn Soldier
steps.text: But it's not my call. If we can't get any useful information out of you, the boss won't want to keep you around.

steps.name: Dublinn Soldier
steps.text: And I can't let you go either. What if you fall into Sarkaz hands again and spill our plans?

steps.name: Dublinn Soldier
steps.text: I say, how about...

steps.name: Dublinn Soldier
steps.text: You join Dublinn?

steps.name: Dublinn Soldier
steps.text: Never mind. If you were Tarans, the boss would've had you change clothes already.

steps.name: Dublinn Soldier
steps.text: It's up to you whether or not you believe me. I, for one, would rather be out there killing Sarkaz than interrogating you bunch.

steps.name: Dublinn Soldier
steps.text: Look, Londinium's fallen into the hands of the devils. And who is to blame for that? Old friend, I heard you barely even put up a fight. You just surrendered to the Sarkaz, one by one.

steps.name: Dublinn Soldier
steps.text: Who made the Victorian Army, once the scourge of all of Terra, so weak and pathetic?

steps.name: Dublinn Soldier
steps.text: Where's your commander? Still wearing a fancy uniform, off drinking with the Sarkaz?

steps.name: Victorian Soldier
steps.text: ...Nngh!

steps.name: Dublinn Soldier
steps.text: The commanders were right. Victoria really is rotten to the core. Without us cauterizing it, this great place will turn into a swamp of rotten detritus that won't even burn.

steps.name: Dublinn Soldier
steps.text: Soldier, you should feel grateful that you get to die at the hands of your former countrymen.

steps.name: Dublinn Soldier
steps.text: At least your pride as a Victorian soldier won't be tarnished by the stench of those devils.
––You people betrayed Victoria, and still have the gall to pay lip service to pride?

steps.name: Dublinn Soldier
steps.text: Who's there?!
I won't let you lay a finger on our troops.
The occupiers are unworthy, and you, Dublinn, are even less worthy.

steps.name: Dublinn Soldier
steps.text: You... You're... the one who fled...

steps.name: Dublinn Soldier
steps.text: Urgh!!
The eighth nest has been wiped out.

steps.name: Victorian Soldier
steps.text: You're... here to save us?
Stand up, soldier.
Let's get out of here first.

steps.name: Victorian Soldier
steps.text: ...Soldier?

steps.name: Victorian Soldier
steps.text: You're... a lieutenant? Which company are you with?

steps.name: Victorian Soldier
steps.text: I didn't think we still had anyone...
Rita Skamandros, 7th Frontline Infantry Battalion, 2nd Tempest Platoon Leader.
Or,

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Horn, if it pleases you.
